newsitem.title: USA: DCI Telecommunications files for offering.
newsitem.headline: DCI Telecommunications files for offering.

text.p: DCI Telecommunications Inc said Monday it intends to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering designed to raise $10 million.
The statement is to be filed within 60 to 90 days, the company said.
The proceeds would be used to finalize a variety of joint ventures and acquisitions, including bridge refinancing for a new subsidiary, to be known as FNet.
In April, the company signed an agreement with Franklin Telecom Corp to acquire between 40 percent and 50 percent of Franklin's wholly owned subsidiary, Franklin Datacom Inc.

The agreement was based on DCI securing a capital infusion for the subsidiary, which is to be named FNet. Besides using the financing to complete the deal, DCI also said it plans to undertake an initial public offering for FNet.
In early August, DCI also signed a letter of intent to acquire Muller Media Inc, a privately held entertainment company in a stock-exchange valued at about $3 million.
